audio_description:
The Lunar Gate powers up around a capsule.
Blue and gold energy pours through it.

context.scene_title: The Lunar Gate — the Esthar space-launch apparatus energizing the cold-sleep capsule (Disc 3).
locations: The Lunar Gate launch facility east of Esthar — a huge ornate machine with a central capsule/pod surrounded by blue and gold energy

characters.name: (launch capsule, occupant unseen)
characters.recognition: A metallic pod at the machine's core, charged with energy; its occupant (Squall/Rinoa/party member) is sealed inside and not visible.

context.summary: Inside the Lunar Gate, an enormous ornate apparatus powers up around a central capsule, brilliant blue and gold energy pouring through the mechanism as the launch sequence charges — the device that fires occupants into space toward the Lunar Base.
context.context_note: Read as the Lunar Gate space-launch apparatus (per the Final Fantasy Wiki: occupants are sealed in capsules and shot into space); the capsule occupant isn't visible in these frames.
